Method of Attack: Packaging malware inside apps disguised as adult video players or fake Flash Players for Android
Requesting admin rights to overlay fake login screens on legitimate banking apps
Targeting home banking mobile apps with overlay popup screens to steal credentials
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones running Android 6.0 and above
Attack Vector: Distribution of infected apps outside Google Play Store
User installation of malicious apps ignoring security warnings
Indicators of Compromise: Apps infected with GM Bot malware
Fake login screens overlaying legitimate banking apps
